context_requirements: Expression of a nitric oxide synthase (NOS1/NOS2/NOS3) in the assayed cell line
Active NOS-dependent nitric oxide signaling that is modulated by the inhibitor
A transcriptional program dependent on NO/cGMP signaling
falsifiers: A reproducible, dose-dependent transcriptional response at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Changes in NOS pathway-related landmark genes or NO-responsive genes that track with NOS inhibition
Consistent expression changes across multiple cell lines despite the absence of NOS expression
